resources.string: Get notified when SafeMobile detects a threat or needs your attention. You can change notification access later in Android Settings.
Help the community anonymously by sharing verified threat hashes. No APK files, file names, paths, package names, or device identifiers are sent. You can turn this off at any time.
Choose a folder such as Downloads so SafeMobile can monitor supported APK files there. Access is limited to the folder you select and can be revoked at any time.
Allow SafeMobile to run reliably in the background so user-enabled monitoring and timely security alerts are less likely to be stopped by battery restrictions.
Overlay access is not required for local scanning. SafeMobile does not draw over other apps; this link only opens Android’s overlay settings for review.
Threat hash contributed to community defense.
